title: Meeting Clancy

nodes.speaker: Clancy Pantermino
nodes.text: Hey kid I'm so damn glad I found you! I'm just scooting through town on some business and something came across my desk that screams your name!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Hey kid I'm so damn glad I found you! I'm just scooting through town on some business and something came across my desk that screams your name!

nodes.speaker: Clancy Pantermino
nodes.text: I guess you must have expressed some interest in the Pantermino International Sales Symposium. Did you know Symposium is an ancient name for Drinking Party? I always loved that.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I guess you must have expressed some interest in the Pantermino International Sales Symposium. Did you know Symposium is an ancient name for Drinking Party? I always loved that.

nodes.speaker: Clancy Pantermino
nodes.text: Well my my my, I wonder what could have happened. I mean it says in my records here that you're incredibly interested in growing your business and... let me see here... ahhh yes, becoming a titan of industry!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well my my my, I wonder what could have happened. I mean it says in my records here that you're incredibly interested in growing your business and... let me see here... ahhh yes, becoming a titan of industry!

nodes.speaker: Clancy Pantermino
nodes.text: I can tell you're a business person. It's in the eyes. I can always tell, you know?! A real gift my mother used to say. What do you do?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I can tell you're a business person. It's in the eyes. I can always tell, you know?! A real gift my mother used to say. What do you do?

nodes.speaker: Clancy Pantermino
nodes.text: Now now, I'm not trying to kiss on the first date. Funny you mention business though, as business is my business if you catch my drift? Of course you do.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Now now, I'm not trying to kiss on the first date. Funny you mention business though, as business is my business if you catch my drift? Of course you do.

nodes.speaker: Clancy Pantermino
nodes.text: Well look, this is starting to feel more like fate than anything else. Let's say we get you signed up?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well look, this is starting to feel more like fate than anything else. Let's say we get you signed up?

nodes.speaker: Clancy Pantermino
nodes.text: I knew I'd come to the right person. So sharp. Yes, I'm an educator. And what started as a symposium is now an entire school. Those who can, teach.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I knew I'd come to the right person. So sharp. Yes, I'm an educator. And what started as a symposium is now an entire school. Those who can, teach.

nodes.speaker: Clancy Pantermino
nodes.text: Straight to the point. I actually respect that. I think you're ready. Let's say we get you signed up?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Straight to the point. I actually respect that. I think you're ready. Let's say we get you signed up?

nodes.speaker: Clancy Pantermino
nodes.text: Well that's kind, but... enough about me. Let's talk about you! Let's talk about how seriously you take this business craft of yours!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well that's kind, but... enough about me. Let's talk about you! Let's talk about how seriously you take this business craft of yours!

nodes.speaker: Clancy Pantermino
nodes.text: Wooooweeeee I'm not sure how much I can teach you! I'm kidding - you have a lot to learn. Ok listen up, you need to keep this to yourself but maybe I can go a little lower. One Fifty.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Wooooweeeee I'm not sure how much I can teach you! I'm kidding - you have a lot to learn. Ok listen up, you need to keep this to yourself but maybe I can go a little lower. One Fifty.

nodes.speaker: Clancy Pantermino
nodes.text: Now now, I do NOT believe that. Look, we go back a long way so I'm gonna offer you something I don't offer to the riff raff. One fifty, you'll make that back tenfold under my tutorship. That's the Pantermino Guarantee.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Now now, I do NOT believe that. Look, we go back a long way so I'm gonna offer you something I don't offer to the riff raff. One fifty, you'll make that back tenfold under my tutorship. That's the Pantermino Guarantee.

nodes.speaker: Clancy Pantermino
nodes.text: Oh... ok... great. Wow, yeah brilliant, I mean, we should maybe work on your haggling skills first off but, welcome aboard the Pantermino International Sales School!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Oh... ok... great. Wow, yeah brilliant, I mean, we should maybe work on your haggling skills first off but, welcome aboard the Pantermino International Sales School!

nodes.speaker: Clancy Pantermino
nodes.text: Playing hard to get, business 101. And dating am I right? No but seriously:

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Playing hard to get, business 101. And dating am I right? No but seriously:

nodes.speaker: Clancy Pantermino
nodes.text: Free! I mean... look maybe just sign up for free. I'd really like it if you did. ...Please.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Free! I mean... look maybe just sign up for free. I'd really like it if you did. ...Please.

nodes.speaker: Clancy Pantermino
nodes.text: Welcome aboard the Pantermino International Sales School. Maybe I'll come up with an acronym at some point. I'll be in touch with information soon!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Welcome aboard the Pantermino International Sales School. Maybe I'll come up with an acronym at some point. I'll be in touch with information soon!

nodes.speaker: Clancy Pantermino
nodes.text: Look. You know where to find me.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Look. You know where to find me.

nodes.speaker: Clancy Pantermino
nodes.text: Just the taster session? Seventy-two weeks Covers all the basic stuff but leaves plenty of room for the intermediate course!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Just the taster session? Seventy-two weeks Covers all the basic stuff but leaves plenty of room for the intermediate course!

nodes.speaker: Clancy Pantermino
nodes.text: And oh boy do I know how to 'can'. Forty years selling everything from fishing rods to Hova mods. You name it I've sold it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: And oh boy do I know how to 'can'. Forty years selling everything from fishing rods to Hova mods. You name it I've sold it.

nodes.speaker: Clancy Pantermino
nodes.text: I'd be happy to take a small deposit of... look you're a friend now so let's say two hundred and fifty Lims?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'd be happy to take a small deposit of... look you're a friend now so let's say two hundred and fifty Lims?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: How do you know me?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: How do you know me?

nodes.text: I didn't express interest in anything like that.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I didn't express interest in anything like that.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I didn't express interest in anything like that.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I didn't express interest in anything like that.

nodes.text: What record?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What record?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: That's none of your business.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That's none of your business.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I work in the restaurant sector.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I work in the restaurant sector.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I work in the restaurant sector.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I work in the restaurant sector.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Get to the point.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Get to the point.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You're selling a course?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You're selling a course?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'm not interested.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm not interested.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Impressive!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Impressive!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Sounds like a deal!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sounds like a deal!

nodes.text: It's a little steep...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It's a little steep...

nodes.text: Not interested.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Not interested.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Maybe next time.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Maybe next time.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Ok, fine.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Ok, fine.
